Class DuringHunt

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.cards.Card
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.Building
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.forEvent.DuringEvent
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.forEvent.DuringHunt
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DuringHunt extends DuringEvent
Building that grants a bonus during the Hunt event: the owner gains +1 food and +1 PP per Hunter card they own (on top of the standard Hunt reward). The bonus is stored in BuildingBonus.setHuntEventBonus() and applied in Hunt.activeEffect().

    • execute

      public void execute(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
      Sets the owner's huntEventBonus flag when the trigger is Trigger.HUNT, so Hunt.activeEffect() grants the extra +1 food/+1 PP per Hunter. players is expected to contain exactly the owning player (see DuringEvent.activeEffect(Set, Trigger)); other triggers are ignored.
